item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 17/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will continue to affect southern China tomorrow. It will be cloudier over the region. A dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China midweek this week. The weather will improve and it will be cold in the morning over the region. With the monsoon persisting, temperatures will be relatively low in the morning and at night over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Jelawat will move across the southern part of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
